address: 26870 Moody Road, Los Altos Hills, CA 94022
geo_notes: Nominatim matched the address directly as a 'farm' feature (37.35401,-122.15633); OSM farm-building outlines named 'Hidden Villa' cluster at 37.3535-37.3543,-122.1568 and Wikipedia gives 37.351361,-122.160987 (Duveneck House area, ~500 m up-valley). Pin is at the farm/visitor entrance off Moody Road.

notes: Official site has few large building photos: the rental catalog (Arlo-hosted) images of Duveneck House, Dana Center, Hostel and Morgan Pavilion are only 720px or smaller, and the WordPress media library's larger 'Duveneck'/'Dana Center' files turned out to be a Cesar Chavez portrait, a goat, and event-table close-ups. 01.jpg (Duveneck House) is kept at 720x480 because it is the best establishing shot; 03 and 04 are CC-licensed Wikimedia Commons photos (attribution required). Hostel sleeps 39 only; meeting spaces are Dana Center, Duveneck House and Morgan Family Pavilion.
